summary: Telecom Argentina filed a Form 6-K reporting the resolutions of its Ordinary and Extraordinary General Shareholders Meeting and Class A and Class D Special Meetings held on April 29, 2026. The meeting approved the annual financial documentation for fiscal year 2025 and addressed retained earnings adjustments, including absorbing negative retained earnings from a voluntary reserve and reclassifying amounts. The board was authorized to distribute up to US$300 million in dividends. The filing is a routine shareholder meeting report with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring.
